description: A PHP class defining an OpenCart admin dashboard controller for customer-related data and UI handling.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for the customer dashboard extension in OpenCart admin panel, handling display and save operations for customer data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering the customer dashboard UI, preparing breadcrumb navigation, configuration data, and view rendering.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the customer dashboard, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns a string with customer dashboard summary data, including total customers and percentage changes.
